# Siddhast

> Siddhast Intellectual Property Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is a consulting and technology company established in 2005, headquartered in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Siddhast partners with businesses, innovators, startups, institutions, and enterprises across India and the SAARC region, delivering integrated services in IT consulting, IT asset management, intellectual property protection, innovation advisory, and digital business solutions.

Siddhast operates through three business verticals: **Siddhast Innovation** (IT consulting and ITAM), **Siddhast Intellectual Property** (trademark, copyright, patent, and design services), and **Siddhast Trade & Commerce** (enterprise software, CRM/ERP, and BuckBuck WhatsApp Business API solutions).

**Corporate office:** Siddhast Intellectual Property Innovation Pvt. Ltd., 1481/A Chandra Vihar Colony, Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh 284001, India

**Contact:** +91 8840091424 | support@siddhast.com | ip@siddhast.com | info@siddhast.com | Landline: 0510-4012932

## Business Verticals

- [Business Overview](https://www.siddhast.com/business/): Summary of Siddhast's integrated consulting and technology services
- [Siddhast Innovation (IT)](https://www.siddhast.com/siddhast-innovation/): IT consulting, digital transformation, infrastructure planning, and IT asset lifecycle management
- [Siddhast Intellectual Property (IP)](https://www.siddhast.com/siddhast-intellectual-property-siddhast-ip/): Trademark, copyright, patent, and design registration; IP strategy; brand protection; startup IP support
- [Siddhast Trade & Commerce](https://www.siddhast.com/siddhast-trade-and-commerce/): Enterprise software, CRM/ERP, cloud platforms, and commercial technology services
- [Our Brands](https://www.siddhast.com/brands/): Siddhast brands and product portfolio including BuckBuck
